notes: Top bar auto-hide, part 2: the reveal poll is now re-armed when a window is focused. The poll only runs while the owner is the foreground window and is killed when a reposition runs while the owner is backgrounded — so a window that was backgrounded and then focused again never got its poll back, and the top bar never appeared no matter where the mouse went. Focusing a window now re-seats its strip and re-arms the poll, so the taskbar-style top-edge reveal works after switching windows. Verified here: 281 automated tests passing, zero clippy warnings on Linux and Windows targets, frontend build clean, and the Windows installer cross-built and signed on Linux (real-PC test still the gate).
